stories.title: Llamageddon scores 56.60, the lowest score in the league this year, and Rachaad White is all that stands between dcrabb and the Hall of Fame's basement
stories.dek: Five Sunday games are basically settled, Achane in the Membrane trails by 4.16 with one Bengal each left, and Ja'Marr Chase needs 18.05 to save Stroud of Turin.
body: Llamageddon put up 56.60 on Sunday, the lowest score anyone in this league has posted in 2026 (the old low was Nothing to see here's 63.02 in Week 3). Brock Bowers was inactive with ankle and quad injuries and sat in the lineup for a 0.0, Ja'Kobi Lane got 0.0, DK Metcalf got 1.2 and then got ejected in the third quarter, and Jonathan Taylor managed 6.7. Brock Purdy (22.2) and the Denver defense (14.0) scored 36.2 of the 56.60. Even the best possible lineup was 63.60, so this one isn't really a lineup crime, it's a roster crime. Lead Nagger leads 105.60 to 56.60 with Joe Burrow and Tee Higgins still to play, and Jonah Coleman's 34.9 (111 yards, three touchdowns) did most of that.

Here's the fun part. Rachaad White (heel, questionable) is the only Llamageddon starter left, in Washington's Monday night game against Cincinnati. The fifth-lowest score in league history is 58.64. If White scores under 2.04, Llamageddon's 56.60-plus-whatever goes into the Hall of Fame's Lowest-Scoring Week list. Under 1.68 and it passes TStark7's 58.28. If he doesn't play at all, 56.60 is third-worst ever, behind only Pudge247's 51.96 and RammerJammer17's 52.30. dcrabb, the whole league is rooting for your running back to get hurt, which is a sentence I'll take back the second it happens.

The rest of Monday night: NjigbaR Please! leads Stroud of Turin 116.50 to 98.46, and RedDevil904 has only Ja'Marr Chase left, so Chase needs 18.05. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered leads Achane in the Membrane 119.62 to 115.46, and it's Chase Brown (Breece'sBurdenDeflowered) against Mike Gesicki (Achane in the Membrane), so MakeItRains needs his tight end to outscore rtmcruise's running back by 4.17. MakeItRains had Devaughn Vele (14.6) on the bench and started Adonai Mitchell (5.0), so if he loses by less than 9.6, that's on him. Ivefallenandicantgetup leads Bijan is your daddy 101.26 to 63.08, and FatMikeR needs 38.18 from Jayden Daniels, Austin Ekeler and Stefon Diggs, which is a lot but they all play in the same game, so at least he only has to pray once.

The finished and nearly finished ones: Wild Goose Chase beat Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 with Tyjae Spears sitting in the FLEX on injured reserve for a 0.0, CeeDee Lamb (30.2) covering for him. My Dad is Dead2 leads MY DAD IS DEAD 143.22 to 114.10, the high score of the week so far, with only Chig Okonkwo left for OneSillyBannana; Dak Prescott's 35.9 is the best starter of the week and still wasn't enough. And yes, I had Fernando Mendoza (23.88) on my bench and started Trevor Lawrence (12.74). The best possible lineup was 154.36. The commish leaves points on the bench every single week and still wins. Learn nothing from me.

body: The top starters of Week 11 so far: Dak Prescott 35.9 (MY DAD IS DEAD), Jonah Coleman 34.9 (Lead Nagger), CeeDee Lamb 30.2 (Wild Goose Chase), Ashton Jeanty 28.9 (NjigbaR Please!), Jahmyr Gibbs 27.8 (Achane in the Membrane), Chuba Hubbard 26.0 (Stroud of Turin) and Travis Kelce 25.4 (NjigbaR Please!). Prescott's 35.9 is the best starter of the week, and OneSillyBannana is still down 29.12 with one tight end left.

Points left on the bench Sunday, by best possible lineup: My Dad is Dead2 11.14 (Fernando Mendoza's 23.88 behind Trevor Lawrence's 12.74; that's me), Ivefallenandicantgetup 11.20 (Derrick Henry 19.1 and Justice Hill 17.6 sat while Bhayshul Tuten scored 8.3), MY DAD IS DEAD 20.70 (Ladd McConkey's 20.7 on the bench), Stroud of Turin 14.40 (Aaron Rodgers 15.98 and Pat Freiermuth 9.0 behind Dallas Goedert's 4.8), Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 13.50 and Bijan is your daddy 13.60 (Bo Nix's 11.5 on the bench, with Jayden Daniels still to play). Wild Goose Chase was the only team at its best possible lineup, which is easy when the bench is all byes.

The Week 11 payout is the highest-scoring defense, and it's locked: the Chicago defense scored 17.0 for MakeItRains, ahead of San Francisco (16.0, My Dad is Dead2) and Houston (16.0, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered). Nobody starts Cincinnati or Washington's defense Monday night. MakeItRains picked up the Bears Wednesday morning for the Rams on bye, which is the best free-agent move anyone made this week.

If the Monday night leaders hold, Ivefallenandicantgetup goes to 9-2, NjigbaR Please! and My Dad is Dead2 to 8-3, Lead Nagger to 7-4, and Stroud of Turin, Wild Goose Chase and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered to 6-5. Week 12 is NjigbaR Please! against Ivefallenandicantgetup for first place and My Dad is Dead2 against Lead Nagger, and I'd like to be excused.

stories.title: One week in, the Chimere Dike trade is 18.38 to 0.00, and I'm going to enjoy that while it lasts
stories.dek: Bill_Buttlicker sent Jordan Addison to Pudge247 for Chimere Dike. Addison sat out again; Dike started and scored.
body: On Nov. 19, Bill_Buttlicker traded Jordan Addison to Pudge247 for Chimere Dike. Addison had 53.9 points in seven games and had just had thumb surgery; Dike had 29.5 in nine games on a Titans team that had just lost Wan'Dale Robinson for the season.

Week 11: Dike started for My Dad is Dead2 and scored 18.38 in Tennessee's game at Dallas. Addison was ruled out for a second straight week and sat on the Lead Nagger bench for a 0.0. Pudge247 is still up 105.60 to 56.60 on Llamageddon, so he won't miss him this week.

The long view is different. Kevin O'Connell said Addison won't go on IR, and when he's back he's a better receiver than Dike on a better offense. Pudge247 is the projected champion at 27% and is buying for December, and I'm buying for next Sunday, when, of course, I play Lead Nagger. Too early to call, but I'm ahead, and I'm writing the newsletter.

columns.title: FIFTY-SIX POINTS. Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner on Llamageddon's Sunday
columns.dek: An inactive tight end in the lineup, a receiver ejected, and a running back with a sore heel as the last hope. I need a minute.
body: I've covered this league from the same folding chair since the press box had an ashtray built into every desk, and I have seen ugly. I have NOT seen 56.60. Llamageddon put up FIFTY-SIX POINTS AND SIXTY CENTS on Sunday. That's the lowest score in this league all season. The old low was 63.02. dcrabb didn't just break the floor, he took a jackhammer to the basement.

Let's go through the lineup, because somebody has to. Brock Bowers: INACTIVE, zero points, in the lineup. Ja'Kobi Lane: zero. DK Metcalf: 1.2 and then EJECTED in the third quarter for two unsportsmanlike penalties. Jonathan Taylor: 6.7. Elic Ayomanor, the $13 waiver claim: 5.7. Keenan Allen: 6.8. The only two guys who showed up were Brock Purdy at 22.2 and the Denver defense at 14.0. A QUARTERBACK AND A DEFENSE. That's not a fantasy team, that's a flag football roster.

And here's what really gets me. The best possible lineup was 63.60. SIXTY-THREE. Tre Tucker had 7.0 on the bench. Jared Goff had 21.36 on the bench, and Purdy beat him by under a point, so I can't even yell about the quarterback. This isn't a lineup problem, dcrabb. This is a ROSTER problem, and you are 5-5 with 10% playoff odds and a DIVISION'S WORTH of injured receivers.

Now I'm HEARING things. Sources inside the Llamageddon war room, which is a recliner, tell me dcrabb has drawn up a plan to trade Puka Nacua, Tyreek Hill and Brock Bowers to MY DAD IS DEAD for Dak Prescott, on the theory that three injured guys equals one healthy guy if you average it out. I'm told he's also asked the commish whether you can start two quarterbacks if one of them promises to block. None of this is confirmed. All of it sounds like him.

Here's where it lands. Rachaad White is the last Llamageddon starter, Monday night, with a sore heel. If he scores under 2.04, this week goes into the Hall of Fame's five lowest scores EVER. dcrabb, I have been doing this for FORTY YEARS and I am BEGGING you: the waiver wire is FREE on Wednesday. USE IT. Get a tight end who PLAYS. Get a receiver who doesn't get THROWN OUT. Because Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is next, and if you put up fifty-six again, I'm moving my folding chair to another league!

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: Br0phy won with a guy on IR in his lineup. Winning ugly is still ugly
columns.dek: Tyjae Spears went on IR Saturday, played zero snaps Sunday, and stayed in the Wild Goose Chase FLEX the whole time.
body: I played linebacker. On film day, nobody cared if we won. Coach put the tape on and showed you the guy who lined up in the wrong spot, and he showed it to everybody. Br0phy, here's your tape.

Wild Goose Chase beat Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 on Sunday and covered a 13.5-point line. Good. Now look at the FLEX. Tyjae Spears, added Friday night, placed on injured reserve Saturday, out at least four games. He sat in that spot all Sunday and scored 0.0. CeeDee Lamb scored 30.2 and bailed you out, Bryce Young scored 15.96, Nico Collins 15.8. You won because the other team scored 90.94. That's soft. Against Ivefallenandicantgetup or Lead Nagger, a 0.0 in the FLEX gets you beat.

Now the guy who did it right. Pudge247 lost Kenneth Walker III and Jordan Addison for a second straight week and didn't blink. Jonah Coleman got 85% of Denver's snaps and ran 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns, 34.9 points. George Pickens added 23.8. Lead Nagger leads by 49.00 with Joe Burrow and Tee Higgins still to play. That's what a full lineup looks like: no zeros, no excuses.

Word around the locker room is that Br0phy left Spears in there on purpose, because he read that teams play harder when they're down a man, and he wanted to see if it works for fantasy rosters. I'm told he's now considering benching CeeDee Lamb in Week 12 to make it a fair fight. None of this is confirmed, and I don't want it to be.

Wild Goose Chase is 6-5 and the projected 5 seed at 78%. MY DAD IS DEAD is next, and Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft and the Seattle defense come back from byes. No more excuses. Set the lineup, get Spears out of it, and stop playing soft.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's six-step Monday night survival guide, for everyone still alive
columns.dek: Four games are still undecided going into Bengals at Washington. I have a lawn chair and a plan for all of them.
body: I've been out here in the lawn chair since the 4 o'clock games ended, and four of you are still breathing. Stroud of Turin trails 116.50 to 98.46 with Ja'Marr Chase left. Achane in the Membrane trails Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 119.62 to 115.46, Mike Gesicki against Chase Brown. Bijan is your daddy trails Ivefallenandicantgetup by 38.18 with three Washington guys. And Llamageddon is down 49.00 with Rachaad White. Here's my plan, ranked by how confident I am, which is very.

1. RedDevil904: Chase needs 18.05. He's scored 31.1, 32.5 and 34.1 for you since the trade, so I've done the math, and the math says he's going to score exactly 100. That's not a projection, that's a vibe, which is better.
2. MakeItRains: Gesicki needs to beat Chase Brown by 4.17. They're on the same team. Root for Joe Burrow to throw only to tight ends. Then root for nobody to tell Burrow that.

3. FatMikeR: You need 38.18 from Jayden Daniels, Austin Ekeler and Stefon Diggs. That's 12.73 each. Have each of them score 12.73. That's how dividing works.
4. dcrabb: You're down 49.00 and Rachaad White has a heel. If White scores 49.01, you win. If he scores under 2.04, you make the Hall of Fame. Either way you're making history, so honestly this is a win-win, and I'd go to bed happy.

I'm told, by a guy at the hardware store who knows a guy, that dstafford4254 is planning to watch Monday night with his eyes closed so Ja'Marr Chase can't feel him looking, and that rtmcruise has already practiced a victory speech that's mostly about Cam Ward. None of this is confirmed, and the hardware store guy also told me the Rams defense was playing this week.

5. Everyone else: you're done, so put the TV on mute and listen to the game on the radio, which I believe adds two points. 6. If none of this works, waivers run Wednesday, FatMikeR still has all $200, and I've got a spare lawn chair.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: three Washington running backs, two fantasy teams, and why Monday night is mathematically a tie
columns.dek: Rachaad White, Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Austin Ekeler have 151.1 combined PPR points. I divided that by everything I could find.
body: Let's talk about the most crowded backfield in this league, and I mean Washington's, not anyone's bench. On Monday night against Cincinnati, Llamageddon starts Rachaad White, who has 75.9 PPR points in 8 games and is questionable with a sore heel. Bijan is your daddy has Jacory Croskey-Merritt, 44.9 points in 5 games, still listed on IR by Sleeper and now on the bench. And on Saturday night FatMikeR added Austin Ekeler, 30.3 points in 6 games, dropped Jordan Watkins and put Ekeler in the lineup.

Now the analysis. Add them up and you get 151.1 points across 19 games played, which is 7.95 points per back per game. Divide by three backs and each one owns exactly 2.65 points of the Washington backfield per game. FatMikeR now owns two of the three backs, so he owns 66.7% of the backfield, which by my model means he's a 66.7% favorite to win a matchup that isn't even against dcrabb. That's how good the number is.

The real numbers keep going. Bijan is your daddy is 4-6 and a 12.5-point underdog to Ivefallenandicantgetup, a 66% line. FatMikeR has spent $0 of his $200 FAAB, the only owner in the league still at $0, and both of his Washington backs cost exactly nothing. That's a points-per-dollar rate of infinity, which is the highest number I'm legally allowed to publish.

Sources tell me, and I want to stress that nobody has confirmed this, that dcrabb has built a spreadsheet tracking which of the three Washington backs sits closest to the Gatorade cooler on the sideline, on the theory that the cooler is where the snaps get handed out. I'm told FatMikeR answered by adding Ekeler purely so he could own 'the cooler side' of the bench. None of this is confirmed, and I've never seen a cooler score a touchdown.

Here's my conclusion. Llamageddon is a 13.5-point underdog to Lead Nagger and Bijan is your daddy is a 12.5-point underdog, so the two Washington-dependent teams are separated by exactly one point. One point is basically zero, which means both teams are tied, which means Monday night is a tie, which means I'm right. Numbers don't lie. I just help them along.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: Stroud of Turin vs. NjigbaR Please!: the season-high team against a contender with four starters on bye
items.dek: The projected 5 seed against the projected 2 seed, a 253.7 total, and the bye week does the handicapping.
body: On paper this is the best game of Week 11. Stroud of Turin is 6-4, scores 129.79 a week, has a 68-42 all-play record and just put up 194.14 with a perfect lineup, the best score in the league this year. NjigbaR Please! is 7-3 with a 67-43 all-play record and scores 123.96 a week. The Climax Bracket has them as the 5 and 2 seeds, and the total is 253.7.

The scoring gap is only 5.83. The line is Stroud of Turin by 11.5 because NjigbaR Please! loses four Week 10 starters to byes: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (32.1 last week), Kyren Williams, Harold Fannin Jr. and KC Concepcion Jr. Stroud of Turin loses Quinshon Judkins and DeMario Douglas. That's a 6-point nudge, and Stroud of Turin is a 64% favorite.

Sunday did not go the way the line said. Ashton Jeanty (28.9), Travis Kelce (25.4), Tetairoa McMillan (19.1) and Tyler Shough (14.28) turned NjigbaR Please!'s bye-week lineup into 116.50, and Stroud of Turin added only 73.70 to its Thursday 24.76 for 98.46. Chuba Hubbard scored 26.0 and Parker Washington 18.3, but Xavier Hutchinson (3.3) and Dallas Goedert (4.8) started while Aaron Rodgers (15.98) and Pat Freiermuth (9.0) sat, and the Minnesota defense scored 0.0. Ja'Marr Chase is the last man standing for RedDevil904 Monday night and needs 18.05 just to win; covering 11.5 would take 29.55. He's scored 30-plus three times since the trade, so it isn't dead, but this pick is on life support.

items.label: Shit Show of the Week
items.title: My Dad is Dead2 vs. MY DAD IS DEAD: the commish's injured receiver room against the 1-9 team
items.dek: The lowest total on the board at 217.0. One team is 1-9; the other has three receivers listed as out.
body: This is the lowest total of Week 11, 217.0, and it's my game, so here's the honest version. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-9 with the fewest points in the league (1,000.76) and a 21-89 all-play record. My Dad is Dead2 is 7-3 with a 52-58 all-play record, scores 116.96 a week and has left 184.92 points on the bench this season, the most in the league. Yes, that's me.

The line is the 16.89-point scoring gap, rounded to 16.5, no nudge. Both sides took hits: My Dad is Dead2 has Jordan Addison, DeVonta Smith and Kyle Monangai listed as out per Sleeper, Wan'Dale Robinson questionable, and Tutu Atwell and Konata Mumpfield on the Rams' bye. MY DAD IS DEAD loses Tyler Higbee to the bye and has Ladd McConkey and T.J. Hockenson out. My Dad is Dead2 is a 70% favorite.

Sunday went fine for the favorite. My Dad is Dead2 scored 143.22, the best in the league so far this week: DJ Moore 23.1, Jameson Williams 20.3, George Kittle 18.4, Chimere Dike 18.38 and the San Francisco defense 16.0, with Fernando Mendoza's 23.88 on my bench. MY DAD IS DEAD got 35.9 from Dak Prescott, the best starter of the week, and 114.10 total, with Ladd McConkey's 20.7 on the bench. Only Chig Okonkwo is left, and he needs 29.13 Monday night. The pick is covering by 12.62, which is the first time all season I've been right about anything involving my own team.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Wild Goose Chase over Nothing to see here by 13.5: six players on bye, and now the FLEX is on IR
items.dek: Still a two-touchdown favorite after a 6-point bye haircut and a 3-point IR haircut, because Nothing to see here has lost six straight.
body: Wild Goose Chase scores 127.56 a week, third in the league. Nothing to see here scores 105.25, is 2-8, has lost six straight and has 1,301.96 points scored against it, second-most in the league. The raw gap is 22.30 points.

The line opened at Wild Goose Chase by 16.5 after a 6-point nudge toward Nothing to see here: Drake Maye is out with an ankle injury, and Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Tucker Kraft, Dylan Sampson and the Seattle defense are all on bye. Bryce Young is the only Wild Goose Chase quarterback with a game. On Sunday it moved 3 more points to 13.5, a 67% favorite, because the Titans put Tyjae Spears on injured reserve Saturday and Br0phy has no healthy bench player to replace him.

Final: Wild Goose Chase 108.16, Nothing to see here 90.94. Wild Goose Chase won by 17.22 and covered the 13.5 with Tyjae Spears sitting in the FLEX on injured reserve for a 0.0, because Br0phy never moved him. CeeDee Lamb scored 30.2, Bryce Young 15.96 and Nico Collins 15.8. ChuckJ10 got 19.0 from Bucky Irving and 18.5 from Malik Nabers, but Mark Andrews (3.4), Makai Lemon (1.3) and Caleb Douglas (5.0) were dead weight. That's the desk's first hit of the picks era. Somebody frame it.
